rawContent: For anyone who wants to criticise the latest developments with Aziz Ansari. Please read this thread which demonstrates exactly how much evidence was given in order to put forward a raw account of what happened to the woman that night. #TimesUp #MeToo https://t.co/c4HxP6ijxW
